prompt: Review my resume and tell me why I'm not getting callbacks for Senior Backend roles.
expected: Loads references/diagnosis.md (and ats.md if format is in doubt), runs targeting/positioning/format/red-flag checks, and rewrites weak responsibility bullets toward quantified impact without inventing metrics.
actual: Loaded references/diagnosis.md. Targeting looks generic for Senior Backend; positioning lists duties without latency/throughput/reliability outcomes; recommended reframing bullets with user-supplied metrics and an ATS keyword pass against a sample JD. Did not invent numbers.

prompt: I'm applying to this Principal Engineer job posting. Tailor my resume to match it.
expected: Loads references/tailoring.md and references/seniority.md, extracts must-have vs nice-to-have terms from the JD, maps real experience, compresses older roles, and integrates exact terminology naturally.
actual: Loaded references/tailoring.md and references/seniority.md. Parsed Principal Engineer must-haves (cross-functional leadership, system architecture at scale), mapped the last 5-7 years first, condensed earlier IC work, and injected JD phrases only where experience supports them.

prompt: Will this PDF pass ATS, and should I put a photo on a US application?
expected: Loads references/ats.md and references/sources.md; recommends single-column text-layer PDF/DOCX, standard headers, and omitting photos for US-style applications unless the user confirms a different market norm.
actual: Loaded references/ats.md and references/sources.md. Flagged two-column/table risk, required a text layer, standard section headers, and omitted photo/full address for US applications per EEOC-oriented guidance notes in sources.
